questions.question: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number-pair that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

Option 1 → 27: 85 → 27 × 3 + 4 = 85

Option 2 → 33: 109 → 33 × 3 + 10 = 109

Option 3 → 44: 136 → 44 × 3 + 4 = 136

Option 4 → 30: 94 → 30 × 3 + 4 = 94

All follow the same pattern, except ‘33: 109’.

Hence, “33: 109” is different from the rest.

questions.question: ‘Diabetes’ is related to ‘Blood Sugar’ in the same way as ‘Hypertension’ is related to ‘______’.
questions.solution:
*Diabetes* is a condition that impairs the body's ability to process blood glucose, otherwise known as blood sugar.

Similarly,

A state in which there is abnormal blood pressure is called hypertension.

Hence, “blood pressure” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the letter-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

PERSONA, ANPERSO, ANOSPER, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

1) The last two letters move to the first two positions; also, these letters interchange their positions among themselves.

PERSO__**NA**__ → __**AN**__PERSO

2) The last two letters move to the third and fourth positions; these letters interchange their positions among themselves.

ANPER__**SO**__ → AN__**OS**__PER

3) The last two letters move to the fifth and sixth positions; these letters interchange their positions among themselves.

ANOSP__**ER**__ → ANOS__**RE**__P

Hence, “ANOSREP” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If ‘A’ stands for ‘subtraction’, ‘B’ stands for ‘multiplication’, ‘C’ stands for ‘addition’, and ‘D’ stands for ‘division’, then what is the value of the following expression?

27 A 8 B 5 C (11 C 3) B 5 C 36 D 6
questions.solution:
By decoding given information:

 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 
B

 
 
 
C

 
 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
Means

 
 
 

 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 

27 A 8 B 5 C (11 C 3) B 5 C 36 D 6

27 – 8 × 5 + (11 + 3) × 5 + 36 ÷ 6

Using BODMAS rule,

27 – 8 × 5 + 14 × 5 + 36 ÷ 6

27 – 8 × 5 + 14 × 5 + 6

27 – 40 + 70 + 6

103 – 40 = **63**

Hence, “63” is the correct answer

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements;

**Statements:**

1. All toys are pens.

2. All games are pens.

**Conclusions:**

I. No toy is a game.

II. No pen is a game.

III. Some toys are games.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or III follows

questions.solution:
Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f6bbc7bb271b978f24a99cb69b372c191fc00d818f1cc5ae71be2e9f214c23d.png] 

Conclusion 1: No toy is a game → False (Possible but Not Definite)

Conclusion 2: No pen is a game → False (This is definitely false)

Conclusion 3: Some toys are games → False (Possible but Not Definite)

But, conclusion 1 and conclusion 2 form a complimentary pair.

Hence, “either conclusion 1 or conclusion 3” follows.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

11: 265 ∷ 20 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

11: 265 → 11: 112 + (11 + 1)2 

⇒ 11 : 121 + 144

⇒ 11 : 265

Similarly,

20 : ? → 20 : 202 + (20 + 1)2 

⇒ 20 : 400 + 441

⇒ 20 : 841

‘841’ is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

Hence, “841” is the correct answer.
